description: Figure 8 illustrates the performance of different audio-language models on two datasets, MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR, as measured by accuracy. The horizontal axis displays the model names—Owen2-Audio-instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Owen-2.5-Omni—listed alphabetically. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled as “Accuracy (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Three bars are present for each model, representing performance on MMAU, MMAR, and a combined measure. For Owen2-Audio-instruct, the MMAU bar is light blue and reaches approximately 34%, the MMAR bar is dark blue and reaches approximately 34%, and the combined bar is a medium blue and reaches approximately 37%. For Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU bar is light blue and reaches approximately 49%, the MMAR bar is dark blue and reaches approximately 43%, and the combined bar is medium blue and reaches approximately 46%. For Owen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU bar is light blue and reaches approximately 61%, the MMAR bar is dark blue and reaches approximately 54%, and the combined bar is medium blue and reaches approximately 57%. The bars are grouped by model, with the MMAU performance bar, the MMAR performance bar, and the combined performance bar adjacent to each other for each model. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
